# UD Lithuanian ALKSNIS

Language: [Lithuanian](/lt/index.html) (code: `lt`)<br/>
Family: IE

This treebank has been part of Universal Dependencies since the UD v2.4 release.

The following people have contributed to making this treebank part of UD: Andrius Utka, Erika Rimkutė, Agnė Bielinskienė, Jolanta Kovalevskaitė, Loïc Boizou, Gabrielė Aleksandravičiūtė, Kristina Brokaitė, Daniel Zeman, Natalia Perkova, Bernadeta Griciūtė.

## Description

The Lithuanian dependency treebank ALKSNIS-UD (Vytautas Magnus University, Kaunas, Lithuania).



This is a new version of the ALKSNIS-UD treebank natively annotated following Universal Dependencies.

ALKSNIS-UD consists of 3,070 syntactically annotated sentences.
Each node of a tree corresponds to a word or another sentence unit (such as punctuation marks or numerals). The following information is presented for each node: a used form, a lemma, and a morphology tag. Dependencies between words are represented by indicating their syntactic functions. The corpus is provided in the CoNLL-U format. Dependency trees can be visualised using the CoNLL-U editor available at https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/conllueditor

Syntactically annotated sentences are annotated according to guidelines of the Universal Dependencies (UD) standard: https://universaldependencies.org/. The Lithuanian UD guidelines are available here: https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/110.
All the sentences are being manually checked and corrected by a group of linguists.
Compiled during 2024–2026.

<h3>Verbs with Reflexive Core Objects</h3>

<ul>
  <li>This corpus contains 24 lemmas that occur at least once with a reflexive core object (<a>obj</a> or <a>iobj</a>). Examples: užtikrinti vystymąsi, išvengti pasikartojimų, kelti pasipiktinimą, kelti prisiminimų, kelti susirūpinimą, lemti pasirinkimą, negarantuoti atsivėrimo, neišvengti pasikartojimų, nepagailėti domėjimosi, nerengti pasirodymų, nevykdyti įsipareigojimų, pareikšti pasitikėjimą, patobulinti išsilavinimą, patvirtinti įsisteigimą, patyrinėti įsitikinimus, reikšti kalbėjimąsi, rodyti susirūpinimą, stebėti pasirodymą, sukelti domėjimąsi, susilpninti pasitikėjimą, ugdyti pasitikėjimą, įtraukti pasimatymus, įvykdyti įsipareigojimus, žlugdyti pasitikėjimą</li>
</ul>

<h3>Relations Overview</h3>

<ul>
<li>This corpus uses 13 relation subtypes: <a>acl:relcl</a>, <a>advmod:emph</a>, <a>aux:pass</a>, <a>csubj:pass</a>, <a>det:nummod</a>, <a>flat:foreign</a>, <a>nmod:arg</a>, <a>nmod:gov</a>, <a>nmod:obl</a>, <a>nsubj:pass</a>, <a>nummod:gov</a>, <a>obl:agent</a>, <a>obl:arg</a></li>
<li>The following 6 relation types are not used in this corpus at all: <a>expl</a>, <a>dislocated</a>, <a>clf</a>, <a>goeswith</a>, <a>reparandum</a>, <a>dep</a></li>
</ul>
